work.description: The act admits secret and honorary chamberlains to the Piana order. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF2150-2152 reads: Datum Romae apud Sanctam Mariam Majorem, sub Annulo Piscatoris, die XX1 Junii MDCCCXL VII Pontificatus Nostri Anno Becundo.
